name: oido-linkedin
description: Manage LinkedIn company pages, messaging, connections, and content via MCP.

settings.name: LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID
settings.description: LinkedIn app Client ID — from LinkedIn Developer Portal → your app → Auth

settings.name: LINKEDIN_CLIENT_SECRET
settings.description: LinkedIn app Primary Client Secret — from LinkedIn Developer Portal → your app → Auth

settings.name: LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN
settings.description: OAuth2 access token — run linkedin_get_auth_url then linkedin_exchange_code to get one

settings.name: LINKEDIN_BASE_URL
settings.description: LinkedIn base URL (leave default unless using a proxy)
